apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.description: Sketch ideas, plan a room, or explain something with a simple hand-drawn whiteboard.

editorial.reason: An approachable canvas for sketching everyday ideas and sharing them as drawings.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial download

evidence.summary: MIT license confirmed at the checked commit
Root package excalidraw-monorepo declares start = yarn --cwd ./excalidraw-app start. Package manager: yarn@1.22.22. Exact manifest verified; installation not tested.
Upstream source and setup documentation reviewed. Transitive dependencies, external connections and macOS runtime behavior have not been exhaustively verified.
Installed from the live PicoRunner Discover catalog into a new managed folder with bundled runtime tools.
Started successfully using yarn run start and opened the Excalidraw Whiteboard.
HTTP 200 verified on the app's localhost address after restart.
Created a rectangle in the browser canvas and undid it; the prior drawing remained unchanged.
Restarted through PicoRunner twice. First restart recovered a conflict with an unrelated IPv4 listener; the second retained the uncontested address and rendered the canvas.
Stopped and deleted only the disposable test installation through PicoRunner. Managed folder removal was verified; both pre-existing imported apps remained.
